rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline with a compact structural change: keep recurrent block activation on the existing curriculum, but square the carry gain for all but the deepest recurrent pass. The hypothesis is that delaying anchor pull while preserving reverse-tail refinement reduces early anchor over-coupling and leaves a cleaner late-phase state for the exact int8+zlib export path.
title: Reverse-Tail Carry Lag
